correctness.rationale: The isolated/dominating recurrence is exact. Adding an isolated vertex appends it to every greedy output and leaves the restricted earlier order uniform; adding a dominating vertex yields the singleton new vertex exactly when it is first, otherwise the process reduces to the earlier graph. Iterating gives the stated support probabilities and PGF. The maximum-size success formula follows because a dominating-born maximal independent set has maximum size exactly before the second zero, after which later dominating steps preserve maximum success with factors \((j-1)/j\). An independent exhaustive reconstruction over every threshold creation string through order 6 matched the full rational output law for every vertex permutation.
